## How we include figures in quarto?

Here we will explore the basis and main data structures in R, for example

### Vectors

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_little_pony <- c("Twilight Sparkle", "Rainbow Dash", "Pinkie Pie", "Applejack", "Rarity")
numbers_Vector <- c(seq(2,30,by=2))
x_log <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)
```
:::


### Matrices

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
A <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
print(A)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2] [,3]
[1,]    1    2    3
[2,]    4    5    6
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
A
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     [,1] [,2] [,3]
[1,]    1    2    3
[2,]    4    5    6
```


:::
:::


### 3D array

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
a <- array(1:27, dim = c(3, 3, 3))
a
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
, , 1

     [,1] [,2] [,3]
[1,]    1    4    7

, , 2

     [,1] [,2] [,3]

[2,]   20   23   26
[3,]   21   24   27
```

:::


### Lists

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_list <- list(
  numbers = 1:3,
  letters = c("a", "b"),
  matrix  = matrix(1:4, nrow = 2)
)
my_list
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
$numbers
[1] 1 2 3

$letters
[1] "a" "b"

$matrix
     [,1] [,2]
[1,]    1    3
[2,]    2    4
```


:::
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
my_list$letters
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "a" "b"
```


:::
:::


### DataFrames

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vector1 <- c(seq(2,6,1))
vector2 <- c(seq(3,7,1))
vector3 <- c(letters[1:5])
df <- data.frame(vector1, vector2)
df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  vector1 vector2
1       2       3
2       3       4
3       4       5
4       5       6
5       6       7
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
df$vectors4 <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)
```
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
id    <- 1:5
name  <- c("Alice", "Bob", "Cara", "Dan", "Enrique")
score <- c(88, 92, 79, 85, NA)

students <- data.frame(id, name, score)
students
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  id    name score
1  1   Alice    88
2  2     Bob    92
3  3    Cara    79
4  4     Dan    85
5  5 Enrique    NA
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
mean(students$score, na.rm = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 86
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
str(students)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
'data.frame':	5 obs. of  3 variables:
 $ id   : int  1 2 3 4 5
 $ name : chr  "Alice" "Bob" "Cara" "Dan" ...
 $ score: num  88 92 79 85 NA
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
is.na(students$score)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE
```


:::
:::


### Add a new column using a condition

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
students$passed <- students$score >= 85
students
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  id    name score passed
1  1   Alice    88   TRUE
2  2     Bob    92   TRUE
3  3    Cara    79  FALSE
4  4     Dan    85   TRUE
5  5 Enrique    NA     NA
```


:::
:::


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
students$grade <- ifelse(
  students$score >= 90, "A",
  ifelse(students$score >= 80, "B", "C")
)
students
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  id    name score passed grade
1  1   Alice    88   TRUE     B
2  2     Bob    92   TRUE     A
3  3    Cara    79  FALSE     C
4  4     Dan    85   TRUE     B
5  5 Enrique    NA     NA  <NA>
```


:::
:::


### Renaming variable names from a dataframe

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
names(students)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "id"     "name"   "score"  "passed" "grade" 
```


:::
:::


### Selecting using square brackets

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 88 92 79 85 NA
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
students[, 3]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 88 92 79 85 NA
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
students[, c("score", "name")]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  score    name
1    88   Alice
2    92     Bob
3    79    Cara
4    85     Dan
5    NA Enrique
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
students[, -1]
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     name score passed grade
1   Alice    88   TRUE     B
2     Bob    92   TRUE     A
3    Cara    79  FALSE     C
4     Dan    85   TRUE     B
5 Enrique    NA     NA  <NA>
```


:::
:::


### Subselecting from a dataframe

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df <- students[students$score > 80, ]
df
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
   id  name score passed grade
1   1 Alice    88   TRUE     B
2   2   Bob    92   TRUE     A
4   4   Dan    85   TRUE     B
NA NA  <NA>    NA     NA  <NA>
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
remove(df)
```
:::

### Importing Data — CSV with readr

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(readr)

# Simulated data (in practice: students <- read_csv("data/students.csv"))
students <- data.frame(
  id    = 1:5,
  name  = c("Alice", "Bob", "Cara", "Dan", "Enrique"),
  score = c(88, 92, 79, 85, 91)
)
students
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  id    name score
1  1   Alice    88
2  2     Bob    92
3  3    Cara    79
4  4     Dan    85
5  5 Enrique    91
```


:::
:::


### Excel with readxl

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

# Simulated data (in practice: grades <- read_excel("data/grades.xlsx"))
grades <- data.frame(
  id      = 1:4,
  znumber = c("Z001", "Z002", "Z003", "Z004"),
  midterm = c(85, 90, 78, 88),
  final   = c(88, 92, 80, 85)
)
grades
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  id znumber midterm final
1  1    Z001      85    88
2  2    Z002      90    92
3  3    Z003      78    80
4  4    Z004      88    85
```


:::
:::

### RData and RDS

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Simulating save/load with temp files
simple_model <- lm(score ~ id, data = students)
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(simple_model, tmp)
model_restored <- readRDS(tmp)
summary(model_restored)
```

### Writing CSV

```{.r .cell-code}

write_csv(grades, "grades_clean.csv")
cat("grades_clean.csv written successfully\n")

```


### Saving RData and RDS

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
save(students, grades, file = "class_data.RData")
saveRDS(students, file = "students_clean.rds")
load("class_data.RData")
students_restored <- readRDS("students_clean.rds")
students_restored
```
